content.title: The Useful Wind
content.narrative:
YY noticed the spinning seed-wing before he noticed the wind itself.

A maple seed-wing is pinned on a twig and spins in one steady direction while loose leaves twitch around it. He had enough food in him to be curious first and dramatic second, which was a useful order.

"Well," YY said. "That is not snack-shaped. Rude, but interesting."

YY used the spinning seed-wing to choose the less windy side of the ridge and saved his breath for foraging. No one had asked him to name it. That helped. YY liked a thing better when it did not arrive wearing a job.

By sundown his food had moved from 0.78 to 0.81, health from 0.82 to 0.83, and attention from 0.84 to 0.86. YY did not say the numbers out loud. He did say, very softly, "Noted."

He came home with the the useful wind behind him, a little more food than he woke with, and one clear place in the wood changed enough to remember.
